title: Granter secures €1.6M to expand its AI grant platform into Spain, Germany, and Italy
what_it_says: Report of 3 November 2026 on Granter's 1.6 million euro round led by 3xP Global, its participants, total funding, expansion plans, PITCH 2025 win and AI Grant Consultant relaunch; quotes CEO Bernardo Seixas.
